historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: equity 5yr CAGR (3.3%) overstates forward growth -- equity is held flat by an ~80%+ payout, and owner FCF has fallen ~16%/yr over both 3 and 5 years from the FY2020/FY2023 peaks. Industry new-contract scale fell 8.2% in H1 FY2026; company revenue +6.7% in H1 FY2026 against a weak H1 FY2025. A ~0% through-cycle rate is selected.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR 3.3% vs revenue 5yr 11.5% and EPS 5yr -3.4%: >30% divergence both ways. Equity growth is suppressed by distributions (dividends paid RMB2.7bn FY2021-25) and revenue growth reflects the FY2020-24 expansion that has now reversed; neither is a forward proxy.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF series (OCF - capex - lease principal - SBC): FY2020 ~886.7, FY2022 ~623.9, FY2025 371.5 (238 ex pledged-deposit release). SBC-adjusted FCF CAGR is close to reported (SBC small, and SBC fell from 65.8m FY2022 to 21.2m FY2025), so the decline is in the cash generation itself, not in stock-paid growth. Working-capital build (contract assets, receivables from stressed clients) is the main cause.

scenario_narratives.base: The China new-home cycle keeps contracting through FY2028 and then stabilises. Greentown keeps its >20% share and its Tier-1/2 skew (64% of new fees in H1 FY2026), so revenue dips ~5% from the FY2026 level before growing ~2% a year. Fee rates on new contracts stay near today's level (60% of new projects above 3%), the reported operating margin holds around 24-25%, and collection leakage from stressed developer and LGFV clients takes 4-5pp off the cash-realised margin. The government 'guaranteed-delivery' mandates run off with no like-for-like replacement, and urban renewal and capital-owner project management stay small. The dividend payout of 80%+ continues.
scenario_narratives.bull: Two things go right. First, LGFV land revitalisation (340-400m sqm nationally) and urban renewal turn into real project-management mandates from FY2028, and the shake-out to ~30 capable firms concentrates share with Greentown and CCMGT. Second, client credit improves, so contract assets stop building and the cash margin recovers toward 26%. That is still about 7-12pp below the FY2023-24 peak, because the fee-rate competition is treated as structural. Revenue grows 3-5% a year.
scenario_narratives.bear: The H1 FY2026 industry contraction (-8.2% new contract scale) continues for three more years as land acquisition by developers and LGFVs keeps falling and the market moves to existing homes. Fee rates compress further in a buyer's market. Credit losses and stalled collections from developer and LGFV clients become a persistent cash drain, taking the cash-realised margin to ~13.5%. Two chairman changes and an auditor change hint that Strategy 2030 slips. Revenue falls about 23% from FY2025 before flattening. The business stays profitable and net-cash, so this is not a solvency case.

valuation_philosophy.summary: A capital-light fee business with net cash, valued on its cash-realised owner FCF rather than its reported profit, because over FY2024-25 a large share of reported profit has ended up in contract assets and receivables from stressed clients instead of cash. Scenarios are built off the FY2025/H1 FY2026 trough, not the FY2023 peak (EBITDA margin then ~38% incl. interest). In every scenario the margin stays below its FY2023-24 level.
key_risks_to_valuation: Cash conversion: if contract assets (RMB1.75bn, +14% in six months) keep building, even the base cash-realised margin is too high
Fee-rate compression continuing as backlog reprices to buyer's-market terms
Industry new-contract volumes falling faster than the base path (H1 FY2026 industry -8.2%)
Credit losses on developer/LGFV clients and on related-party balances (RMB436m due from related parties)
Governance churn (two chairman changes, auditor change to KPMG) during the Strategy 2030 pivot
RMB/HKD translation of a CNY valuation against an HKD quote; fx_rate is not refreshed automatically

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 1.64-3.39 HKD
data_sources.financials: 9979.HK_Metrics.csv (core_metrics), FY2025 annual report (income statement, cash-flow statement, notes 7-8), H1 FY2026 interim report (balance sheet at 30 Jun 2026, EPS note, share capital note, interest income note)

inputs.share_count_basis: Diluted weighted-average 1,969.369m from the H1 FY2026 EPS note (interim report, six months to 30 Jun 2026). 2,000m shares issued, of which 33.27m held by the share-award trusts (1,966.7m outstanding ex-trust). Held FLAT: SBC is expensed in the flows; the 10m-share Oct-2025 buyback (RMB27.8m) is the first and only one, so the flat count is a modelling convention, not something the company funds.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report cash-flow reconciliation (share-based payment expense RMB21.18m); no net-share-settlement tax withholding disclosed (EquityAwardTaxes = 0 every year).
inputs.fx_note: HKD per CNY 1.1744, Yahoo Finance CNYHKD=X at 2026-10-23T21:58Z. Model runs in CNY (statements are RMB'000); per-share values converted to HKD at this rate (model -> quote = multiply). Direction check: HK$1.69 / 1.1744 = RMB1.44 per share, consistent with the ~RMB0.21 FY2025 EPS giving a ~6.9x trailing P/E that matches published screens. No dual listing exists for a parity check; the rate is not refreshed by refresh_price.py.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-23T08:08:08Z HKEX regular close (Yahoo chart API); 52-week range 1.64-3.39
inputs.wacc_rationale: All-equity (no bank borrowings), so WACC = cost of equity, built in CNY: China 10y government bond ~1.8% + beta 1.15 x 7.0% China ERP = ~9.9%, rounded to 10.0%. Same WACC in every scenario: China-property cyclicality and client credit risk are charged in the scenario flows and the 30% bear weight, not stacked on the rate (adaptation f).
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B), leases as operating cost: lease principal RMB6.6m + lease interest RMB0.5m (FY2025 cash-flow statement / note 8) charged as lease_cost_pct ~0.25% of revenue; lease liabilities (RMB6.5m at 30 Jun 2026) excluded from net debt; D&A path for cash tax excludes right-of-use depreciation.
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows are consolidated (100% of subsidiaries); NCI charged once by deducting the NCI book stake (RMB85.3m, 30 Jun 2026) in the equity bridge. NCI's profit share has been negative (FY2025 -RMB33.1m: loss-making non-wholly-owned subsidiaries), so attributable profit exceeds consolidated; the deduction is mildly conservative.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component route, scenario-weighted, plus owner-fcf-adaptations (RMB flows / HKD quote, leases, NCI, non-operating assets). Routed as a capital-light operating services company (third-party real-estate project management 'daijian'): it earns fee income, holds no land or housing inventory and no bank debt, so none of the bank/REIT/LIC/developer rows apply. First valuation of this ticker (no prior DCF, no memory entry). FY0 = FY2025 (Dec year-end); Y1 = FY2026. OWNER FCF FY2025: OCF 415.2 - PPE capex 12.9 - intangibles 3.0 - lease principal 6.6 = reported 392.7 (CSV FCF 399.4 = OCF - 15.8 capex, ex-lease); less SBC 21.2 = 371.5. Interest income (P&L RMB37.1m) is NOT inside reported FCF because the company classifies interest received in investing activities (RMB8.1m FY2025), so interest_income is 0 in the deduction and the component EBITDA is built from gross profit - S&M - admin, which excludes it by construction. FY2025 OCF is flattered by a RMB133.5m release of pledged deposits (non-recurring); ex that, owner FCF was ~RMB238m. CASH-REALISED MARGIN: reported operating EBITDA (GP - S&M - admin + D&A + SBC) was 24.1% in FY2025 and ~26.5% in H1 FY2026, but cash conversion has been poor for two years as contract assets and receivables from stressed developers/LGFV clients build (contract assets +RMB212m in H1 FY2026 alone; FY2024 working capital consumed ~RMB765m). The ebitda_margin_path is therefore a CASH-REALISED margin: reported operating margin less ~4-5pp of persistent collection leakage / expected-credit-loss normalisation. This is the single most important judgment in the model and is deliberately below both the FY2023-24 peak (~33-38%) and the current reported run-rate. NET CASH: bank balances and cash RMB1,402.2m at 30 Jun 2026; pledged bank deposits RMB117.5m excluded (restricted against project guarantees). Interest on a small loan from a third party (RMB2.5m FY2025) sits inside other payables and is ignored (immaterial). Contingent consideration on the Zhejiang Greentown Shangli acquisition is inside trade and other payables and is treated as operating. Equity bridge: see equity_bridge items. HOUSE vs STREET: SBC is small (0.68% of revenue), so the house/street band is narrow but not collapsed.

bear.wc_capture_pct_rationale: Set to zero rather than -25%: in this case falling revenue would mechanically release working capital, but the bear case is precisely the one where stressed clients pay later, so the release is assumed to be absorbed by slower collections.
bear.narrative: The new-build market keeps contracting at the H1 FY2026 industry pace (-8%), fee-rate competition and LGFV/developer credit losses compress the cash-realised margin to ~13.5%, and urban renewal never becomes material.

base.growth_rates_rationale: FY2026 +2%: H1 +6.7% on a weak comparable, H2 FY2025 was strong (RMB1,746m) so H2 FY2026 likely flat-to-down; new contracted fees RMB3.41bn in H1 FY2026 vs RMB9.35bn for FY2025 point to a shrinking intake. FY2027-28 decline as the lower FY2025-26 intake converts to revenue; recovery to 2% (nominal RMB, roughly inflation plus modest share gain) from FY2030.
base.ebitda_margin_path_rationale: Cash-realised margin: reported operating EBITDA ~24-26% less ~4-5pp collection leakage/ECL; dips as backlog reprices to lower fee rates, recovers slightly to 21% as receivables stabilise. Y1 owner FCF ~RMB415m, in line with FY2025 reported (371.5) and above its ex-pledged-deposit figure (238).
base.cash_tax_rate_path_rationale: PRC 25% EIT plus ~3pp effective dividend-withholding leakage on remittances to the HK holdco at an ~80% payout; FY2025 cash tax was 34% of PBT (non-deductible impairments), H1 FY2026 effective 25.7%.
base.wc_capture_pct_rationale: Net operating working capital ~32% of revenue (contract assets + receivables + related-party receivables less payables, contract liabilities and related-party payables); -25% capture on revenue change.
base.narrative: China's project-management industry keeps shrinking for two more years, then stabilises; Greentown holds its >20% share and fee rates settle near the current level.

bull.narrative: Urban renewal and LGFV land revitalisation become revenue-material from FY2028, consolidation lifts share, collections normalise; margin recovers to 26% -- still well below the FY2023-24 peak, by design.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 10x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised to 30% from the 15% default: the addressable market is shrinking now (industry -8.2% H1 FY2026), cash conversion has been poor for two years because of client credit stress, and governance has turned over twice. Base 50%: H1 FY2026 shows stabilisation (revenue +7%, gross margin 41%, admin and S&M -7%). Bull cut to 20%: it needs both a policy-driven demand pool that management itself calls exploratory and a turn in client credit.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
